newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR DRIFTS LOWER BUT TRADE MINIMAL.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR DRIFTS LOWER BUT TRADE MINIMAL.

text.p: White sugar futures resumed their corrective downward trend in early Thursday trading but interest was again extremely quiet before the open of the New York raws market, traders said.
All positions were slightly weaker by 1150 GMT, although March attracted most of the thin overall volume of 346 lots.
Benchmark October stood $1.00 lower at $323.70 and December was down by the same amount at $320.70.

October has been gently edging lower since a wave of fund buying pushed it to a new contract high of $331.00. But traders and analysts have said nearby support at around $323 still looks fairly solid.
In fundamental news, Syria tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of whites and 13,000 tonnes of raws for October shipment. The deadline for offers is September 9.
It also tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 20.
Syria announced it had bought 13,000 tonnes of white sugar at $374.70 per tonne from Lorico for Sepember delivery, It cancelled an earlier raws buying tender.
Just 24 lots of front-month October were traded on the Paris market. The contract was down 70 cents at $323.60. Nothing was traded on Matif's lesser-quality 100 ICUMSA white sugar market.
